name: com.getmcpads/linkedin-ads
title: LinkedIn Ads
description: LinkedIn Ads MCP server: 18 read tools, 15 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Member access token from your own LinkedIn app, with r_ads and r_ads_reporting. Keep it secret.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Programmatic refresh token. With the client ID and secret, the token is renewed in memory.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated numeric ad account IDs this server may access, 1 to 100. Required even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Scopes actually granted to the token. When set, writes require rw_ads.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes the 15 write tools. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn-Version header as YYYYMM. Defaults to 202608.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_ADS_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: debug, info, warn or error. Logs go to stderr. Defaults to info.
